verdict.description: One sentence: whether actionable findings exist and the most serious one.

findings.description: Every previous active finding exactly once (REMAINS, RESOLVED or WITHDRAWN), then new findings (NEW). Order by priority, P0 first.

status.description: NEW for a finding not in the previous review. REMAINS, RESOLVED or WITHDRAWN for each previous active finding.

title.description: Short title. For a previous finding, copy its title exactly.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the changed file. For a previous finding, copy its file exactly.

line.description: Line in the head commit, or null when the finding has no single line.

body.description: At most 80 words: evidence, impact, smallest fix.

reason.description: Required for RESOLVED (what changed) and WITHDRAWN (the verified reason and the line that proves it). Omit for NEW and REMAINS.
